registry.reviewedBy: Fearless 4.2.0 release lead decision record (Portfolio / token grouping); issuer lists checked 2026-10-10

untrustedAssets.reason: Kusama AssetHub Assets id 11 is a third-party token that names itself USDT (metadata USDT/USDT, 4 decimals; owner, issuer and admin H4DU1hKQeLkR5bhMeMidarF9bVvrH3k6ybLz84YLs7eRQMu; supply 69,000,000,000; one holder; not sufficient), read on 2026-10-10. It is not Tether's: Tether's deprecated Kusama asset is id 1984 ("Tether USD", USDt, 6 decimals). The registry calls id 11 "tether usd" with priceId tether, which would value anyone's airdrop of it at $1 per token.

groups.name: Polkadot
groups.review: Native DOT on the relay chain and system parachains plus XCM reserve-backed DOT at the same precision. Excluded: SORA-bridged DOT (18 decimals), disabled Parallel and Equilibrium, and liquid or voucher derivatives (LDOT, LCDOT, TDOT, VDOT).

groups.name: Kusama
groups.review: Native KSM on the relay chain and system parachains plus XCM reserve-backed KSM at the same precision. Excluded: SORA-bridged KSM (18 decimals), disabled Khala and Mangata, and derivatives that share priceId kusama (vKSM, vsKSM, LKSM, taiKSM).

groups.name: Ethereum
groups.review: Native gas ETH on Ethereum and on rollups whose canonical bridged native gas asset is ETH. Excluded: every WETH (different asset, priceId weth), Binance-Peg ETH on BNB Smart Chain, SORA-bridged ETH and wstETH.

groups.name: Tether USD
groups.review: Only deployments on Tether's published supported-protocols list that are present in the registry. Separate rows: bridged USDT on Polygon, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet, Polygon zkEVM and X Layer; XCM-reserve USDT on parachains; SORA-bridged USDT. The registry's Kusama AssetHub "usdt" is not Tether's: it is Assets id 11, a third-party 4-decimal token, and is listed in untrustedAssets. Tether's own (deprecated) Kusama AssetHub asset is id 1984, "Tether USD" (USDt, 6 decimals), which the registry does not list.

groups.name: USD Coin
groups.review: Only Circle-issued native USDC from Circle's published contract-address list that is present in the registry. Separate rows: USDC.e on Polygon, Arbitrum One, OP Mainnet and Polygon zkEVM; Binance-Peg USDC on BNB Smart Chain (18 decimals); the registry's X Layer and Kaia USDC (not Circle's addresses) and Polygon zkEVM USDC (not on Circle's list); XCM-reserve USDC on Pendulum; SORA-bridged USDC.

groups.name: Bitcoin
groups.review: Native Bitcoin only (app-owned network). Excluded: WBTC, BTC.b, kBTC and iBTC, which are wrapped or bridged representations with their own risks. A single-member group renders as a plain row.
